question: Did any Asobi release take cloud code from Pylux after Pylux source was published?
limits: String-level only. Shared strings are mostly Sony endpoints, OAuth scopes and JSON keys that any client of the service must use; they show a common protocol, not copying from Pylux. Asobi stripped most log text after 1.1.9, so control flow ported without strings would not be detected.
use: Do not claim Asobi copied Pylux source. The Forward Technologies claim rests on the PSStream binary (see psstream-steam-build.json).
